# Imagix — Free Online Image Toolkit

Imagix is a free, browser-based image toolkit. All processing runs locally in the
user's browser using JavaScript and the Canvas API; images are never uploaded to a server.

## Supported output formats
- PNG: lossless, supports alpha (transparency).
- JPEG: lossy, no alpha channel; smallest file size for photos.
- WebP: supports both lossy and lossless, supports alpha; smaller than PNG at similar quality.

## Tools and how they work
- Resize: new dimension = original × (scale / 100). Aspect-ratio lock keeps width/height
  proportional: height = width × (origH / origW).
- Compress: savings %% = (1 − outputBytes / originalBytes) × 100 for lossy formats.
  PNG is re-encoded losslessly, so it may not shrink.
- Convert: re-encodes the image into PNG, JPEG or WebP.
- Crop: selects a rectangular source region defined by (x, y, width, height) in source pixels.
- Rotate: rotating 90° swaps dimensions: newWidth = oldHeight, newHeight = oldWidth.
- Watermark: draws text with selectable position (9 anchors), font size (px), color and
  opacity (0–100%).
- Image to Base64: encodes image bytes as a base64 Data URL; size ≈ 1.37 × binary size.
- Filters: brightness(%), contrast(%), saturate(%), grayscale(%), sepia(%), invert(%), blur(px).

## Privacy
Images are processed on-device. No image content is transmitted to Imagix servers.
Third-party partners (Google AdSense, Amazon Associates) may set cookies, web beacons and
collect IP addresses for ads and attribution. See privacy.html.
